[P2] Include the runtime endpoint in AgentCore permissions

Granting `bedrock-agentcore:InvokeAgentRuntime` only on the runtime ARN leaves calls denied on the runtime endpoint. The base extras README and `compute/agentcore/agentcore.ts` already document this requirement. Update this table and the `agentCoreTransport` JSDoc to require permission on both the runtime ARN and the selected `<runtime ARN>/runtime-endpoint/<qualifier>` resource, or `/runtime-endpoint/*`.
